cross_cutting_findings.detail: Requires EVENTSTORE_ADMIN_URL absolute http(s) and trimmed EVENTSTORE_ADMIN_TOKEN; typed client Bearer token, Accept application/json, 10-second timeout; redirects disabled. No per-call token/actor/tenant identity forwarding, no OAuth server. stdio logs stderr only. Source names do not prove live visibility.

cross_cutting_findings.finding: Human identity and role gates survive migration
cross_cutting_findings.detail: Admin controllers require EventStoreHuman as well as exact AdminReadOnly/AdminOperator/AdminFull policy. ReadOnly accepts ReadOnly/Operator/Admin, Operator accepts Operator/Admin, Admin requires Admin. MCP confirm is caller Boolean and not authenticated human intent. Workload/public-agent credentials cannot be relabeled human by inventory. Effective technical-route admission and selected environment remain separate proof.

cross_cutting_findings.finding: Tenant scope is a real server gate
cross_cutting_findings.detail: Applicable route/query/body actions check canonical tenant grants. Current optional-list filters with no tenant may require explicit platform scope path/permission; MCP client adds no X-Hexalith-Scope. Do not copy historical global-Admin listing assumptions or treat session tenant as authority; verify selected host behavior before parity.

All seven write tools default confirm:false, validate before preview, and make no request until confirm:true; validated preview fields equal executed values. Confirms do not flow as backend human proof. Reset explicitly clears projection state. Replay reprocesses, pause/resume change execution, cancel preserves partial results; all require separate generic safety/auth/audit decisions.

Tools return strings containing camelCase indented JSON and camelCase enum names, not McpCli OperationResult documents. Success sanitizer replaces raw payload/state/old-new/config/details/cursor and other properties with protected descriptors; messages bounded to 240 chars, unsafe markers/display controls redacted, max traversal depth 64. Error documents have error:true/adminApiStatus/message; HTTP401/403 collapse unauthorized; invalid JSON/timeouts/network mapped. Ping and partial types-list have their own envelopes. Preserve or approve output changes; stream-read descriptions are not permission to leak raw contents.

cross_cutting_findings.finding: No invented support from Admin HTTP-only methods
cross_cutting_findings.detail: Assembly tool attributes enumerate exact 28; no MCP resource/prompt/lifecycle subscription registration. Many Admin HTTP APIs (snapshot, restore/import/erasure/rotation etc) have no MCP tool here and must not be invented as current MCP operations. Separate CLI inventory may include them. No model-context skill-resource reader in this host.

TriggerBackup service returns false/ErrorCode Deferred. Controller explicitly recognizes Deferred; inventory must not describe backup trigger as functioning backup creation. No selected-environment execution or completion evidence gathered.

cross_cutting_findings.finding: Existing tests are source evidence only
cross_cutting_findings.detail: Exhaustive write-call, invalid-input zero-request, and published tool-inventory source checks exist. DW2 protocol acceptance scaffold includes Skip attributes, so source tests alone are not live MCP acceptance. No tests run during this investigation.
